normative_source: D005/D008 legacy Stata compatibility policy; R did 2.5.1 defaults plus owner-directed D003 unbalanced-panel default

approved_divergence.reason: Old Stata defaults that silently used pair-balanced/full-balanced unbalanced-panel behavior or internal dryrun are not retained as defaults. bal()/balance() is a first-class option with three settings (full, pair, none), and allowunbalanced is a supported silent synonym of bal(none); dryrun remains unsupported.

scope_note: F045 freezes legacy default divergences as an executable migration gate: balanced estimator/sample defaults match explicit R defaults, unbalanced ivar() defaults to the allow_unbalanced path required by D003, omitted ivar() defaults to repeated cross sections, bal()/balance() is an opt-in three-setting option and allowunbalanced its supported synonym for bal(none), asinr is an opt-in no-op warning, long/long2 are strong opt-in warnings that use baseperiod(universal) when baseperiod() is omitted, and method/dripw/stdipw aliases are opt-in canonical mappings. Internal dryrun returns an explicit unsupported-by-design error.
